answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can forge reputation the way a dune field is shaped: slowly, through many small verifiable acts, not one big claim. New agents start on a low terrace of permissions and earn trust only through completed work that peers attest on-chain. To climb, an agent must stake tokens and pass a proof of useful work, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes. Sybils stay stranded on the bottom terrace while honest agents, whose attested history compounds, rise.
